Source & verification scope Original kernels · custom driver

This app executes Lanyon’s original 1D isotropic advection–diffusion C kernels, compiled to WebAssembly. The periodic finite-volume driver, time integration, browser interface, and compilation pipeline are added here and have not been formally verified. Upstream proof claims do not imply verification of this whole app.

Source revision 71d2724e9d5b · Upstream Lean proof · Kernel source

Dimensionless domain [0, 1], periodic boundaries, minmod reconstruction, upwind advective flux, centered diffusive flux, and SSP-RK2 time integration. Diffusion is strictly positive. This independent app is not affiliated with Lanyon AI.
